quotes.title: Kepler-8
quotes.card: Kepler-8 is a star located in the constellation Lyra in the field of view of the Kepler Mission, a NASA-led operation tasked with discovering terrestrial planets.
quotes.introduction: The star, which is slightly hotter, larger, and more massive than the Sun, has one gas giant in its orbit, Kepler-8b.
